Implementation Plan

Ready-to-implement plan for the final report-and-removal issue of tracking project 8895. It changes exactly two files under `analysis/`. Checking the cited code turned up four mismatches with the issue's verdict list, covered in the "Conflicts" section; the plan says how each is recorded so no verdict is written unchecked.

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-8895` at `69900392f660d5a9990aa2e0810e1c5eead73c5a`. "Integration branch mismatch" is `false`. Default-branch reference: `isolated-base`.

## Files likely to change
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-03-2.md` (deleted)
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`

## Automation / scheduling (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** no new script and no edit to an existing one. Only two documentation files change.
- **Scheduler entry point:** none is added. `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` already treats any path listed under `## Processed source docs` as handled (it reads the report through `APPLY_ANALYSIS_REPORT_PATH`, default `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`). Listing this doc there and deleting the file is the existing way to mark it done.
- **Supervisor:** none needed.
- **Database work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry is needed.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md
Scope-mode justification: The issue fixes the scope at two files: delete one source doc, and add to the report's existing processed-docs list and outcome ledger. The plan copies the format of the latest entry (`### analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-03.md`, report lines 1965–2007), so no new structure is added. The advisory test file `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py` is left alone. Its tests build their own sample reports (for example `test_doc_listed_in_processing_report_is_skipped_without_search`, line 302) and never read the real report or this doc. The issue's own constraint, "Touch only the two files listed", wins over that advisory list. The full option (re-check every verdict, fix the inaccurate ones) costs only a few extra report rows, so it is chosen over copying the decomposition verdicts as written (§6: Correctness & safety ranks above Speed).
